enchantments.tooltip: +15 Enhancement Bonus: +15 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Chilling 7: This effect causes the edges of this weapon to become frozen to the touch, dealing 7d6 Ice damage on each hit.
Freezing 16: This effect causes the edges of this weapon to become frozen to the touch, dealing 16 to 96 Ice damage on each critical hit.
Legendary Freezing Ice: On hit, this has a chance of freezing your enemies in solid ice. Struck enemies must make a DC 100 Fortitude save or be frozen solid.
Dragon's Edge 7: +23% Enhancement bonus to bypass enemy Fortification. On Crit: 7d8 Bleeding Damage to those that are vulnerable to it.
Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
